items.title: India Energy Week moves to Kolkata, to be held from January 28-31 next year
items.summary: India Energy Week 2027 will be held in Kolkata from January 28-31, marking a shift from Goa, where a Rs 1,000-crore convention centre was built as a permanent venue. The fifth edition will take place at the Biswa Bangla Convention Centre in New Town, with preparations reviewed by Oil Minister Hardeep Singh Puri.

items.title: GOBARdhan Scheme can help reduce gas imports by $5 billion, says IBA
items.summary: The GOBARdhan Scheme is expected to significantly reduce India's gas import bill. This initiative aims to convert organic waste into clean energy sources. The scheme will also decrease fertilizer imports and subsidy burdens for the nation. It is projected to create numerous employment opportunities in rural areas.

items.title: India’s $40 billion Russian oil lifeline shouldn’t buckle under Trump’s 100% tariff threat: GTRI
items.summary: As long as it proves to be economically feasible, India should persist in acquiring Russian crude oil. A new Senate bill from the US threatens to impose significant tariffs on countries engaging in Russian energy purchases. Being one of the leading buyers, India might suffer trade penalties. This leads to a critical choice between accessing cheaper oil and retaining US export possibilities.

items.title: India has built energy resilience to withstand external shocks, says Puri
items.summary: India has enhanced its energy security by diversifying crude oil supplies. Strategic infrastructure expansion and domestic exploration investments are key initiatives. The nation is better prepared for geopolitical disruptions than ever before. New schemes aim to accelerate deepwater oil and gas exploration efforts. India's growing energy demand will significantly drive global oil consumption.

items.title: L&T bags major offshore orders worth Rs 5,000-10,000 crore from ONGC for pipeline replacement
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro has secured significant offshore orders from ONGC. These orders are valued between five thousand and ten thousand crore rupees. The projects involve pipeline replacement and well head platforms off India's west coast. L&T Energy Hydrocarbon Offshore will execute these critical engineering projects. This reaffirms L&T's role in developing India's energy infrastructure.

items.title: India cuts energy import dependence to 42%, oil imports still meet 90% of demand: CII-EY
items.summary: India's primary energy import dependence has decreased to forty-two percent by FY25. Crude oil imports still meet nearly ninety percent of domestic demand. Natural gas import dependence has increased to about fifty percent. Coal import dependence has fallen to around eighteen percent due to production. Energy security requires clean energy and domestic production for resilience.
